title: How he tunes his drums
summary: He tunes each drum to the sound he wants, and drums become seasoned over time.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: How do you tune your drums? Everybody tune their drums differently. That's a good question.

I mean, I can sit here and tell you for half an hour and you would go and tune yours differently. I tune mine to, not necessarily a key, per se, but I tune them to the sound that I want each one of them, the tum tum, excuse me, two tum tum snare drum and the bass drum. And then after you've had them a while, they become seasoned. And then just in that climax has a lot to do with it. It'll loosen up their heads, you know.
